answer: Locks are published in ferrous, expire in beacon, and terrace lists each expiry. An attacker running 193 aliases hence needs 148 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2240 identities would post 4082 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
